Greenhouse gas emissions (measured in tonnes of CO2 equivalents). Citation: Jones et al. (2025), via Our World in Data (lastUpdated: 2025-12-04, timespan: 1850-2024). World (tonnes CO2e): 1996: 39,997,944,000, 2005: 45,006,918,000, 2010: 49,602,090,000, 2015: 52,119,314,000, 2020: 50,601,267,000, 2023: 54,092,186,000, 2024: 54,433,400,000. United States (tonnes CO2e): 1996: 6,806,676,000, 2005: 7,428,800,500, 2015: 6,408,285,700, 2020: 5,758,456,000, 2024: 6,054,308,400. United Kingdom (tonnes CO2e): 1996: 764,923,100, 2005: 714,899,840, 2015: 518,771,400, 2020: 411,773,630, 2024: 390,275,420. European Union (27) (tonnes CO2e): 1996: 4,609,470,000, 2005: 4,429,507,600, 2015: 3,781,346,000, 2020: 3,280,848,000, 2024: 3,036,264,200.
